title: How Kirk Telegram account attribution became uncertain
summary: Tracks a viewer’s matching-contact observation and Owens’s shared-account alternative in Episode 396. The progression concerns attribution of displayed messages; account ownership, authorship and message authenticity remain unverified.

milestones.label: Viewer flags contact match
milestones.proposition: Viewer Hannah Doodle, read by Owens, observes that Erika’s American-flag Telegram contact matches the contact name on Charlie’s purported texts leaked by Andrew Wilson.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 3870–3900s. The viewer’s identity is unverified, and the matching icon/contact observation alone establishes neither account ownership nor message authorship or authenticity. This is an attributed lead about the particular displayed exchanges, not an independent determination that Erika wrote Charlie’s messages.

milestones.label: Shared access qualifies attribution
milestones.proposition: Responding to the matching-contact observation, Owens reports TPUSA sources describing a shared American-flag account and a separate donor account, while explicitly saying she does not know whether Erika took over the shared one.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 3885–3967s and statement-0e6abf494202. The unnamed-source account supplies an alternative to inferring a single author from a contact icon; ownership, access history and who wrote any particular message remain unverified. Statement-dd372508cb66 is Owens’s quotation attributed to Kirk from the donor account, not authenticated account metadata. No inference connects this account ambiguity to the older warning-message app dispute.
milestones.statement_text: Owens said TPUSA people told her Charlie Kirk had two Telegram accounts: an American-flag account others could access and a Charlie Kirk account used with donors; she explicitly did not know whether Erika took over the former.
milestones.speaker: Candace Owens

evidence.text: Owens said TPUSA people told her Charlie Kirk had two Telegram accounts: an American-flag account others could access and a Charlie Kirk account used with donors; she explicitly did not know whether Erika took over the former.
evidence.speaker: Candace Owens
excerpts: Yeah, it is certainly interesting. I am told by Turning Point people that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) had two Telegram accounts, one which was accessible by people around him where he would like kind of be like the fake Charlie (Charlie Kirk). Sometimes it was the real one had access to it. ... But, like, other people also had access to it and could communicate, and that's the American flag icon. And then the real Charlie (Charlie Kirk), the one that was speaking to the donors, the one that says Charlie Kirk, that we saw when he's like, "I've been left with no choice but to ban the pro-Israel cause." That, yeah, I've realized the American flag thing is interesting. I don't know if Erika (Erika Kirk) took over that account. I don't know what's going on. I believe nothing that comes from Andrew Wilson, because why would you send it to Andrew Wilson when you could send it to Andrew Kolvet?
